selection_basis_seen_before_freeze: repository is public data/code for Molecular Dynamics Simulations of Deformable Viral Capsomers
data/simulation contains parameterized bd_b*_e2.3 directories with numbered cluster files

data_contract.systems: all data/simulation/bd_b*_e2.3 directories present at target repository snapshot
data_contract.ordering: numeric suffix of cluster<N> files; no manual omissions
data_contract.parse_rule: for each cluster<N> UTF-8 text file, remove blank lines and comment lines beginning with #; tokenize remaining lines on whitespace. Define structural_mass S_N as total count of parseable integer tokens after the first token of each data line. If no such tokens exist, PARSE_FAIL for the entire gate rather than inventing a substitute statistic.
data_contract.reason_for_parse_rule: uses only the numbered cluster output itself and is fixed before contents are viewed

frozen_hypothesis.name: EARLY_FIRST_BREAK_CARRIES_LATE_ASSEMBLY_INFORMATION
frozen_hypothesis.claim: Across independent parameter regimes, the earliest persistent regime break in the ordered cluster-derived structural_mass sequence predicts late structural_mass rank better than an early-window aggregate mean alone.

first_break.candidate_points: all positions after at least 10 observations and before end of feature window
first_break.persistence: absolute post/pre mean difference >=0.5 pooled early-window standard deviations and same sign when recomputed on the next 5 observations

first_break_features: normalized break location or 1.0 for NO_BREAK
frozen_analysis.primary_endpoint: leave-one-system-out absolute rank error for late outcome; first-break feature model must beat aggregate baseline in >=ceil(0.6*Nsystems) held-out systems
frozen_analysis.secondary_endpoint: Spearman association between standardized break shift and late outcome rank exceeds absolute Spearman association of early mean with late outcome rank

temporal_null.method: within each system, deterministically permute feature-window sequence order by SHA256('C033'||system||permutation_index||original_index), preserving the value multiset and late outcome
temporal_null.score: number of held-out systems in which first-break beats aggregate baseline
temporal_null.requirement: native primary score must be strictly above the 95th percentile null score

promotion.PASS: internal JANUS first-break operator transports to an independently authored viral capsomer simulation corpus under the frozen parse/statistical rules
